question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM customers LIMIT 500

question: How many orders are completed?
sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 500

question: Which city has the most customers?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many products are in each category?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category LIMIT 500

question: What is the average product price?
sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products LIMIT 500

question: What is the total revenue from completed orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 500

question: How many orders are there for each status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status LIMIT 500

question: Top 5 products by revenue
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Top 5 customers by total spend
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS total_spend FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show monthly revenue for 2025
sql: SELECT SUM(price * quantity) AS revenue, TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month FROM orders LEFT JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id LEFT JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id WHERE orders.status = 'completed' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') LIMIT 500

question: Which product category has the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT category, SUM(price * quantity) AS revenue FROM order_items INNER JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id INNER JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id WHERE orders.status = 'completed' GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 500

question: How many completed orders were placed in March 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date = CAST('2025-03-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 500

question: What is the most expensive product?
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total quantity sold for each category?
sql: SELECT category, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id WHERE orders.status = 'completed' GROUP BY category ORDER BY category LIMIT 500

question: How many customers are in Delhi?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi' LIMIT 500

question: How many customers placed more than 15 orders of any status?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE id > 15 LIMIT 500

question: What percentage of all orders were returned, rounded to 1 decimal place?
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 1) FROM orders LIMIT 500

question: What is the average order value by city for completed orders?
sql: SELECT city, AVG(p.price * oi.quantity) AS avg_order_value FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY city ORDER BY city LIMIT 500

question: Which month (YYYY-MM) had the most cancelled orders?
sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the total revenue in 2026 for each category?
sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY') AS year, TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, p.category, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01' AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM'), p.category, TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY'), o.order_date ORDER BY TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM'), p.category LIMIT 500

question: Which 3 cities have the highest revenue from completed orders?
sql: SELECT c.city, COALESCE(SUM(p.price * oi.quantity), 0) AS revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many distinct customers have completed an order containing an Electronics product?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id WHERE status = 'completed' AND category = 'Electronics' LIMIT 500

question: Across all orders regardless of status, what is the average quantity per order line for each category?
sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, p.category, AVG(oi.quantity) FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM'), p.category ORDER BY TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM'), p.category LIMIT 500

question: Which customer placed the most orders of any status?
sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many completed orders were placed in the first quarter of 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 LIMIT 500
